answer: Think of the honest agents as a grove of distinct, rooted trees: a sybil attacker wants a thousand saplings but has soil for one. Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond and collect attestations from an existing quorum before its votes carry weight. Spinning up a whole nebula of cheap clones then costs real capital per node, and a lone sparrow of an unvouched identity never accrues standing. Because cost scales with the number of identities, not their claims, flooding the economy stops paying.
